prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 3 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1125; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
text: Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection, reporting neck and back pain beginning immediately after the event. Over three visits, the patient was evaluated and managed for cervical and lumbar strain. The reported injury pattern is consistent with the mechanism of a lateral impact of this kind. Examination documented paraspinal muscle tenderness and restricted range of motion in the neck and lower back, and imaging findings clearly confirm the soft-tissue injury. No prior injury to the same body regions is known from the patient's history. Treatment followed a typical course of conservative care, including manual therapy, stretching exercises, and short-term anti-inflammatory medication. Symptoms and function improved steadily across visits, and care was tapered accordingly. Two similar claims submitted on the same day are currently under routine review, and this summary does not alter that process.
